paragraphs: Rabbi Pinchas ben Aruba, a Tanna of a baraita.
Mentioned in [Gittin 56b](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.56b.16), saying, “I was among Rome's leading men; when Titus died, they opened his brain,” etc.
In [Bekhorot 38b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bekhorot.38b.19), Rabbi Yochanan gives a medical teaching in the name of Rabbi Pinchas ben Aruba.[^2]

notes.text: The brain-opening narrative is quoted as Hyman reports it; the medical teaching is a separate attestation.

[Heilprin’s entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2959&lang=en) cites both passages. The Gittin passage recounts what was reportedly found when Titus’s skull was opened. In Bekhorot, Rabbi Yochanan attributes the amount to be fed to the animal, a dried fig’s bulk, to Rabbi Pinchas.
